verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical skyscraper resizes. In each, the photo is cropped down to a sliver of sweater, so the woman, mug and gift box are gone, and the headline 'A GIFT' runs onto the busy knit pattern. Both also have a ragged layout: the centered cafe logo and copy sit against a left-hung 'Only this Christmas' and stars, the URL is pushed right, and 'with your next' breaks awkwardly onto its own line. A has slightly more even vertical spacing. B jams the headline up under the gift icons and leaves a large gap below the dashed rule.
